phase: route3 C1 Blender B2-only under plan4.11
problem: 在已知几何、对应时刻参考外观与统一光圈合成条件下，隐藏层能否稳定优于O5、BokehMe及Oracle-input Dr.Bokeh；并补MoVieS来源/运动诊断

preregistration.quality_rule: PSNR OR LPIPS, plus frozen secondary-metric guard, dual-sign stability and full/in-focus PSNR guards

B2-high.pixel_class_assignment: actual recovery, then parallax-sufficient priority; remaining recovered pixels motion-required; mixed flags retained in GT

B2-low.pixel_class_assignment: actual recovery, then parallax-sufficient priority; remaining recovered pixels motion-required; mixed flags retained in GT

geometry.GT_scale: meters, GT poses/intrinsics; axial focus depth
geometry.stable_surfaces: object plus triangle plus local point/barycentric tracking
geometry.foreground_alpha: 4x4 exact first-hit subpixel coverage for declared foreground objects
geometry.reference_check_domain: same object/triangle/depth and7x7 eroded interior; does not claim unchanged boundary antialiasing
geometry.residual_handling: drop any residual-ray pixel from primary/subregion masks; retain in full-image and in-focus guardrails

profile.evidence: independent synthetic checker K1 PSNR82.66dB and off-grid plane minimumalpha.9915 before any B2 method output

composition.layers: joint visible+hidden per-ray depth ordering and alpha blend, remaining T times same Cfill, average in linearRGB

C_fill.function: one fixed LaMa fill per scene/frame; project lens-ray point at local deep-static background axial depth back to center
C_fill.composition: merge visible+hidden Gaussians, depth sort per subcamera, sumTalphaC, then remaining T*Cfill, averageK; never precover hidden with LaMa
C_fill.background_depth_convention: local deep-static center depth after all semanticFG removed; zero=no finite surface ->10km approximation
C_fill.border_sampling: shared border extension, report projected-outside fraction
C_fill.notes: local plane and Gaussian discretization, not a perfect optical Oracle

composition.RGB: common sRGB[0,1] LDR inputs for2D and3D; true inverse transfer before3D integration; raw HDR EXRs retained; no added HDR advantage
composition.O6_rec_name: 可恢复表面的 GT Oracle

statistics.PSNR: pool float64 RGB SSE/(3*validpixels) across eligible main frames/apertures within EACH scene and focus, then -10log10; report each aperture separately too
statistics.patch: fixed64px nonoverlapping grid, whole unmasked RGB patch; region score weighted by region pixel support; pool across items by regional pixel count
statistics.patch_limitation: receptive field includes pixels outside narrow region; no mask-outside zeroing
statistics.RGB: all methods common display sRGBfloat[0,1], inputs from clipped scene-linear pinholes; GT unclipped EXR only converted/clipped for quality; raw linear retained for noise

Cycles_GPU.boundary: sum render+EXR-write calls only; excludes process startup, PNG conversion, copying reused images and CPU analysis

CPU_geometry_measured.limitation: sum of recorded job-stage wall times, not CPU-core seconds or overall elapsed; scenes/jobs ran concurrently; reference-geometry generation and validation not timed here

Cycles_GPU.boundary: sum render+EXR-write calls only; excludes process startup, PNG conversion, copying reused images and CPU analysis

CPU_geometry_measured.limitation: sum of recorded job-stage wall times, not CPU-core seconds or overall elapsed; scenes/jobs ran concurrently; reference-geometry generation and validation not timed here

scoring.measurement: filesystem birth-to-last-write of successful eval log, includes imports/local LPIPS load,CPU metrics and12montages; not isolated network-core time

threeD_render.boundary: synchronized GPU lens rendering and conversion, excluding cloud preparation and CPU output writes

LaMa.boundary: Per-item model calls, diagnostic statistics and NPZ/PNG output writes; excludes model setup/loading and inputNPZ reads

O3.boundary: Per-item model calls, diagnostic statistics and NPZ/PNG output writes; excludes model setup/loading and inputNPZ reads

Oracle-input Dr.Bokeh.boundary: Per-item model calls, diagnostic statistics and NPZ/PNG output writes; excludes model setup/loading and inputNPZ reads

observations: 官方示例和B2手持视频均观察到当前来源低alpha/低premultiplied RGB诊断PSNR，全来源明显改善
结合前轮C0/C1，能排除本项目来源编号错配和同组渲染器不一致；现象不能只归因于Cam固定机位
B2已知动态位移与对应有明显误差，静态与同帧位移误差小；不能由该探针单独认证源深度或推广为模型架构定理
B2当前来源全图约9–11dB，但动态球区域21.68–28.18dB、alpha0.924–0.956；全图低分不代表运动主体区域也统一低到9dB，RGB误差并非单独运动头分数
MoVieS.input_scale: GT input geometry canonicalization and official meanXYZ normalization, model_to_world3.782527m; no posthoc depth-only fit

conclusions.observed_mechanism: high两档焦点均通过O6-GT-rec相对O5的机制及6/6同向；正信号主要由相机视差可恢复表面提供
conclusions.method_value: high两档焦点对BokehMe的LPIPS同向及全图0.2dB护栏未通过，完整判据均不通过；对Oracle-input Dr.Bokeh通过
conclusions.route_judgment: 本轮证据不足以支持直接转入隐藏层/混合渲染训练；保留隐藏层边际机制观察，等待用户决定是否另行定位合成差距或调整主贡献
limits: 一个受控主场景及其低CoC对照，每焦点6个主组合，不是跨场景泛化证据
有限K16、高斯离散、局部深背景面、参考视角外观及LDR限制；O5/O6并非完美光学Oracle
64patch LPIPS感受野包含窄区域外像素，按冻结口径完整保留
O6−O3/Dr不是单因素归因，O6-GT-rec不是收益上限，all−rec不是可恢复占比
